The body is authoritative; the title and assignee are derived views. Only the sitting seat PM writes it. Body refreshed 2026-10-16T20:02Z: every design child of objectui#12446 has landed (objectui#12450–#12456, #12453); its test-pass cards remain. **The epic objectui#12446 is closed** (summary `6206354798`, close-out `6209577658`, on the maintainer's 「可以，关闭史诗 #12446」); the seat's scope is now the `domain:ui` lane queue. Round 2 (§2): objectui#12623, #12612, #12620 and #12611 landed; the `next.2` consumer bump objectui#12626 (filed and claimed by this seat) landed too. Round 3 on the maintainer's 「补」: objectui#12627 landed, and objectui#12626 landed as PR objectui#12648 (expedited on the maintainer's word); objectui#12608's objectui half landed as PR objectui#12658; objectui#12604 landed as PR objectui#12687 (`f0e760a`). objectui#12653 landed as PR objectui#12699 (`e6175b5`), so every eager-closure ceiling is 20% higher. objectui#12606 landed as PR objectui#12662 (`c41ce3f`) under ruling C. objectui#12673 landed as PR objectui#12738 (`b393152`) under ruling A. objectui#12701 landed as PR objectui#12748 (`e219a3d`). objectui#12705 landed as PR objectui#12754 (`80863ad`). objectui#12695 landed as PR objectui#12773 (`0171c24`). objectui#12702 (PR objectui#12776), objectui#12707 and objectui#12708 are in flight. objectui#12704 (the dashboard KPI tiles' height) waits on the maintainer: the height is authored `layout.h`, not a platform constant, so the card is on `needs-user-decision` (analysis `6222913929`). Decisions go on cards, on the maintainer's 「需要我决策的开决策卡」; the skill wording is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23934. objectui#12406 and #12486 were taken by `domain:ui` seat 1. The batch drops to 3 after these. objectui#12634 (this seat's objectui#12612 pin in the merge queue) closed as fixed on `main`. The console-home cards objectui#12602, #12604 and #12605 are held behind seat 1's objectui#12601.
